plugins.name: save-your-work
plugins.description: Two Claude Code skills for automatic development session tracking. /saving-progress saves progress after every task and resumes from where you left off. /continue-progress recovers crashed sessions instantly.

skills.name: continue-progress
skills.description: Recover a crashed or interrupted development session. Reads the last checkpoint in .project/PROGRESS_TRACKING.md and resumes immediately from the next pending task — no questions asked.
skills.description_zh: 从 .project/PROGRESS_TRACKING.md 的最后检查点恢复崩溃或中断的开发会话，直接接续下一待办任务。

skills.name: saving-progress
skills.description: Start a development session with automatic progress checkpoints. Reads or generates .project/PROGRESS_TRACKING.md, asks user what to do (or resumes automatically in automode), and saves a checkpoint after each completed task and phase.
headings: Step 4: Auto-checkpoint — run after EVERY completed task
skills.description_zh: 启动带自动进度检查点的开发会话，读取或创建 .project/PROGRESS_TRACKING.md，询问任务或在自动模式恢复，并在每个任务和阶段完成后保存进度。

headings: Add the community marketplace (only needed once)
→ reads PROGRESS_TRACKING.md, shows: "Last completed: Task 8. Next: Task 9 — Setup auth middleware. Continue?"
→ ⚡ Resuming... Last completed: Task 8. Next: Task 9. Picks up immediately.
→ PROGRESS_TRACKING.md doesn't exist. Reads PLAN.md, generates tracking file with all tasks as ⏳ Pending, then asks where to start.
→ resumes from Next Task silently, checkpoints after every task without asking anything.
